description: Header file defining the RecordBufferConverter class used for audio format, channel, and sample rate conversion in Android's media processing.

classes.name: RecordBufferConverter
classes.description: A class for converting audio buffers between different formats, channels, and sample rates, with legacy handling for mono/stereo conversions.

methods.name: RecordBufferConverter
methods.description: Constructor initializing conversion parameters for source and destination audio formats.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts input data from an AudioBufferProvider to a destination buffer.

methods.name: initCheck
methods.description: Checks if the constructor was successful.

methods.name: convertNoResampler
methods.description: Performs format conversion without using a resampler.

methods.name: convertResampler
methods.description: Performs format conversion using a resampler, modifying source in-place.
